decisions.reason: The construction site dumper draws on the firm's vehicle and haulage engineering, but it was only mentioned rather than presented, and the related mining trucks were already dropped, so its fit and the firm's ability to learn from its results are uncertain.

The inclined furniture lift line builds directly on the firm's lifting and material-handling know-how, has its own page and several models, and the firm's service capabilities let it interpret customer feedback and keep improving the product.

The inclined building material lift fits closely with the firm's construction and lifting expertise and shares technology with the furniture lift, so the firm can assimilate learning across both lines.

The truck-mounted version combines the firm's vehicle and lifting knowledge and shares components with the inclined lift line, though as a single model it is somewhat more exposed than the full lines.
